title: New Figma File: file template (templates/<id>.json)
description: One file template. The file name is its id.

order.description: Position in the File type list (lowest first).

label.description: Text in the File type list.

heading.description: Heading of the details step (defaults to label).

nameLabel.description: Label of the name field, e.g. "Project name".

fields.description: Form fields shown besides the name.

pages.description: Pages to build, in order: names of pages in _shared.json, or full page definitions.
